Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your email. Insperity Organizational Planning offers the ability to create charts or directories from data stored in a variety of file formats, databases, and directories.
You can view the job aid here for assistance with importing employee data in the format required by Insperity Organizational Planning. If you have any additional questions or if I can be of further assistance, please let me know.
Thank you,
